_description: Publish docs/presentation/index.html to Confluence automatically after every edit. Requires CONFLUENCE_* variables in the environment or a .env file at the repo root.
_install: Merge the 'hooks.PostToolUse' array below into your .claude/settings.json
_requires: pip install beautifulsoup4 lxml requests  +  CONFLUENCE_* env vars or .env

hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"filePath\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$f" == *docs/presentation/index.html ]] && { [ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a; uv run --with beautifulsoup4 --with lxml --with requests python scripts/publish_to_confluence.py; } || true'
